conventions.convention: N_ab counts transitions from b to a; N^0 is the identity, N^(n+1)=NN^n, and D_n=(N^n)_00. Length-zero paths are included.
H_n=C^(D_n) and rho_n=I/D_n are assigned only when D_n>0; zero counts receive no normalized operator. Inner products are linear in the first argument.
Entropy uses natural logarithms, sums over positive eigenvalues, and assigns zero contribution to zero eigenvalues; its unit is the nat.

The Temperley–Lieb loop parameter is real, n≥1, and only quantum integers [2]_δ through [n]_δ must be nonzero; [n+1]_δ may vanish. Diagram multiplication stacks the left factor above the right, and tower maps append strands on the right.
The representation is unital and complex-linear, every generator image is self-adjoint, and the represented Jones–Wenzl element has strictly positive rank.
Ordinary Hilbert-space trace and unnormalized diagram closure trace are separate functionals; their agreement requires an additional trace-preservation hypothesis.
A_4=4a is independently assigned formal mathematical data with a>0; it is not identified with geometrical area or physical entropy.

load_bearing.statement: A finite nonempty label set with distinguished label 0 and a nonnegative-integer transition matrix defines D_n=(N^n)_00; for D_n>0, H_n=C^(D_n) and rho_n=D_n^(-1)I_Hn. No normalized rho_n is assigned when D_n=0.

The number of length-n paths from 0 to a is (N^n)_a0. Whenever D_n>0, rho_n is a density matrix with entropy log D_n in nats. For N=((0,1),(1,1)), D_0=1, D_1=0, D_2=1, and D_(n+2)=D_(n+1)+D_n for every n≥0.

For n≥1, real δ, and nonzero [2]_δ through [n]_δ, take a unital complex-algebra representation of P_n(C,δ) on a nonzero finite-dimensional complex inner-product space with self-adjoint generator images, and require P=pi(Phi_n^(-1)(p_n)) to have positive rank.

Under the finite Hilbert representation data, P is an orthogonal projection; if r=rank P>0, rho=P/r is a density matrix with entropy log r in nats. Separately, Tr_n(p_n)=[n+1]_δ and tr_H(P)=r; equality is not asserted without an additional trace-preservation hypothesis.

alerts.finding: The text following the TikZ figure says 'the right-hand cup-cap is U_r'. The figure draws the two p_r boxes centered at x=0.5 between vertical strands x=0 and x=1, while its cup-cap lies separately on x=2 and x=3. Thus the displayed components are disjoint, whereas U_r in (p_r⊗1)U_r(p_r⊗1) must connect the final strand of p_r to the newly appended strand. The boxes also do not meet the drawn strands. The algebraic formula is correct, but the convention-aid diagram does not faithfully depict its strand incidence.
